title: Ranking Top 40 Highest Potential Crypto Altcoins 2026/2027
summary: Crypto YouTuber ranks 40 altcoins by upside for the coming altcoin season, citing a manufacturing index signal, and promotes a grid-trading bot affiliate.

assertions.quote: the ISM or the manufacturing index in the USA pushing towards 58, which has historically been the catalyst that has created major altcoin seasons

verdicts.note: The link rests on a couple of past cycles; with so few data points it has no demonstrated predictive power for altcoin prices.

assertions.quote: there's not that many people left silly enough to start buying into these massive spikes
lots of potential room to move back up to previous kind of excitement areas
The only way you're going to gain here is to buy into good coins with high conviction

verdicts.note: Most altcoins never regain prior highs, so holding through drawdowns usually locks in losses rather than gains.

assertions.quote: Make sure you have got more money in the bigger market caps because they're less vulnerable to news
I've been making an absolute killing over here
crypto markets do potentially get bigger and bigger each and every kind of time we go through sort of a cycle

verdicts.note: Total crypto market cap has made higher peaks across cycles and ETF access grew, but most individual tokens shrank, and past cycles do not guarantee the next.

assertions.quote: I added more as the price fell.
you can have like a punt on the side at some of these smaller caps
